rows.label: tlk43400046_02_msg0001
rows.name:
My dad runs the Wildschwein
Mercenaries.

rows.label: tlk43400046_02_msg0002
rows.name:
They have some real roughnecks but
they know how to handle themselves.

rows.label: tlk43400046_02_msg0003
rows.name:
Recently, the Hræsvelgr Mercenaries
lost their leader, didn't they?

rows.label: tlk43400046_02_msg0004
rows.name:
They were good at what they
did, so I'm just glad we've
one less competitor.

rows.label: tlk43400046_02_msg0005
rows.name:
I think buying them out now would be
the best move... Perhaps I should
suggest it to Father.
